paragraphs: Rav Sama bar Rakata says she is betrothed, and Ravina says she is not (Heilprin’s report; in Kiddushin 9a the attributions are reversed). Bava Metzia, Asheri 10b: before Ravina, in Rav Avya's name. The Gemara there, Bava Metzia 10b,, in שס״ח [provisionally the new Shas], mentions only Rav Sama without further designation.
